title: Steering Language Model Refusal with Sparse Autoencoders
reasoning: The paper benchmarks the impact of feature steering on several knowledge domains related to faith and ethics, specifically reporting accuracy regressions on MMLU sub-categories such as 'Moral Disputes', 'Moral Scenarios', 'World Religions', 'Philosophy', and 'Business Ethics'. It also includes a specific ablation study on a 'Philosophy' feature.
